definitions.finality: Per call: client submission to successful finalized receipt lookup; percentiles include finalized watches only
definitions.completion: First split/load submission to last settled final wave watch; includes split audit and claim signing
definitions.readiness: Per member: submission to first finalized poll with root coverage; observed-ready population only
definitions.resourceScope: Node/host samples span fixtures, smoke and pilot. Driver RSS samples are separately labelled by stage.
limitations: No measured weight-versus-execution-cost or PVF deadline verification
